from datetime import datetime

# Login to simple_note
simple_note_creds = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
login_resp_sn = apis.simple_note.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password=simple_note_creds['password'])
access_token_sn = login_resp_sn['access_token']

# Find relevant note(s) by searching for 'The Lord of the Rings'
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
candidate_notes = []
while True:
    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token_sn, query='The Lord of the Rings', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at')
    print('notes page', page_index, 'count', 0 if not resp else len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    candidate_notes.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('candidate notes', [(n['note_id'], n['title']) for n in candidate_notes])

# Extract titles directed by Peter Jackson from candidate note contents
jackson_titles = []
seen = set()

for n in candidate_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token_sn, note_id=n['note_id'])
    content = note['content']
    # Parse: track last non-bullet, non-heading line as potential title
    last_title = None
    for raw_line in content.splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if line.startswith('-'):
            # director line?
            if line.lower().startswith('- director:'):
                director = line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
                if director == 'Peter Jackson' and last_title:
                    if last_title not in seen:
                        seen.add(last_title)
                        jackson_titles.append(last_title)
            continue
        # Otherwise it's likely a title
        last_title = line

print('Peter Jackson titles extracted:', jackson_titles)

# If none extracted, fall back to using note titled 'Movie Recommendations'
if not jackson_titles:
    resp_notes = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token_sn, query='Movie Recommendations', page_index=0, page_limit=20, sort_by='-updated_at')
    print('fallback search notes', resp_notes)
    for n in resp_notes:
        note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token_sn, note_id=n['note_id'])
        content = note['content']
        last_title = None
        for raw_line in content.splitlines():
            line = raw_line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            if line.startswith('-'):
                if line.lower().startswith('- director:'):
                    director = line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
                    if director == 'Peter Jackson' and last_title and last_title not in seen:
                        seen.add(last_title)
                        jackson_titles.append(last_title)
                continue
            last_title = line

print('final jackson_titles:', jackson_titles)

# Prepare comma-separated message
message = ', '.join(jackson_titles)
print('message to send:', message)

# Login to phone
phone_creds = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='2444880289', password=phone_creds['password'])
access_token_phone = phone_login['access_token']

# Send to Leslie Ball
leslie_phone = '7873383923'
send_resp = apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=leslie_phone, message=message, access_token=access_token_phone)
print('send_resp', send_resp)
